d: A major land dispute has emerged near the Prime Minister's residence in New Delhi. The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) has moved to reclaim approximately 40 acres of land occupied by the Air Force Sports Complex at Race Course Air Force Station. The sudden closure of the complex, including its golf course, led to the cancellation of outgoing Indian Air Force Chief Air Chief Marshal AP Singh's farewell golf event.
